props.name: autoInsertSpace
props.description: We add a space between two Chinese characters by default. Set `autoInsertSpace` to `false` to disable.
props.descriptionZh: 我们默认提供两个汉字之间的空格，可以设置 `autoInsertSpace` 为 `false` 关闭

props.name: block
props.description: Option to fit button width to its parent width
props.descriptionZh: 将按钮宽度调整为其父宽度的选项

props.name: classes
props.description: Customize class for each semantic structure inside the component. Supports object or function.
props.descriptionZh: 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的 class，支持对象或函数

props.name: danger
props.description: Syntactic sugar. Set the danger status of button. Will follow `color` if provided
props.descriptionZh: 语法糖，设置危险按钮。当设置 `color` 时会以后者为准

props.name: ghost
props.description: Make background transparent and invert text and border colors
props.descriptionZh: 幽灵属性，使按钮背景透明

props.name: href
props.descriptionZh: 点击跳转的地址，指定此属性 button 的行为和 a 链接一致

props.name: htmlType
props.description: Set the original html `type` of `button`, see: [HTML Standard](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/button#type)
props.descriptionZh: 设置 `button` 原生的 `type` 值，可选值请参考 [HTML 标准](https://developer.mozilla.org/zh-CN/docs/Web/HTML/Element/button#type)

props.name: iconPlacement
props.description: Set the icon position of button
props.descriptionZh: 设置按钮图标组件的位置

props.name: loading
props.description: Set the loading status of button

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: (Global config only) Set the loading icon of button
props.descriptionZh: （仅支持全局配置）设置按钮的加载图标

props.name: shape
props.description: Can be used to set button shape

props.name: styles
props.description: Customize inline style for each semantic structure inside the component. Supports object or function.
props.descriptionZh: 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的行内 style，支持对象或函数

props.name: target
props.description: Same as target attribute of a, works when href is specified
props.descriptionZh: 相当于 a 链接的 target 属性，href 存在时生效

props.name: type
props.description: Syntactic sugar. Set button type. Will follow `variant` & `color` if provided
props.descriptionZh: 语法糖，设置按钮类型。当设置 `variant` 与 `color` 时以后者为准

events.name: click
events.description: Callback executed when button is clicked

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Set the icon component of button

slots.name: loadingIcon
slots.description: Set the loading icon component of button
slots.descriptionZh: 设置按钮载入的图标组件

commonProps.name: rootClass
commonProps.descriptionZh: 添加在组件最外层的 className

commonProps.name: autoFocus
commonProps.description: Auto focus when component mounted, only effective for focusable elements like forms, links, etc.
commonProps.descriptionZh: 自动获取焦点，仅对表单类、链接、交互容器等可聚焦元素生效
